headline: Romanians' pensions, a 'time bomb' approaching. Adrian Negrescu: 'In the next 7-10 years the problem could become critical'
summary: Romania's public pension system is entering a critical period amid population ageing and rising life expectancy. Adrian Negrescu said the problem could become critical in the next 7-10 years.
why: Pension liabilities drive public spending and sovereign fiscal planning, which in turn affects government bond yields and budget deficits.

original_headline: Pensia românilor, „bomba cu ceas” care se apropie. Adrian Negrescu: „În următorii 7-10 ani problema poate deveni critică”
